planets.name: Kepler-1651 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-1651 with a 9.88-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: Kepler-1651 b was found in 2017 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-1651. Its orbit and size follow Mann et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
